The bidder shall submit a valid PAN Card along with the latest 30Lakh CA-certified Turnover Certificate. The bidder's annual turnover shall as per mentioned in file. The submitted certificate must clearly mention the turnover details and be duly certified by a Chartered Accountant. 2. The bidder shall submit a notarized self-declaration/undertaking confirming that the firm/organization ha s not been banned, debarred, suspended, or blacklisted by any Central Government Department, St ate Go vernment Department, Government Organization, PSU, or any other Government Buyer. The undertaking must be notarized on or after the bid publication date and before the bid submission end date. Any declara tion notarized or issued after the bid submission end date shall not be considered valid or accepted for the purpose of this bid.submit a self-attested and notarized copy of the valid GST Registration Certificate along with the technical bid. The GST certificate must be valid and verifiable as on the date of bid submission. Fai lure to submit the required notarized GST Registration Certificate may result in rejection of the bid as per t he tender terms and conditions 3. The bidder shall quote and supply 100% Make in India products, wherever applicable. The bidder shall s ubmit the required Make in India declaration/supporting documents along with the bid clearly mentio ning the country of origin and applicable local content details. 4. The bidder must submit a valid MSME Udyam Registration Certificate and a valid GST Registration Certificate, Valid Shop & Establishment Registration along with the bid. The details submitted must be vali d and verifiable as on the date of bid submission. Mentioned More certification for food catering services te nder

5. The bidder/agency must have a declared/authorized service Centre or service support arrangement at t he consignee location, as required for providing after-sales/service support. The bidder shall submit docu mentary proof of the service center/establishment, such as GST registration, incorporation /registration cer tificate, valid address proof, authorization letter, or other relevant supporting documents. 6. The bidder must submit the physical/original copy of the EMD to the concerned Department before th e Bid End Date and Time specified in the GeM Bid. If the physical/original EMD is not received by the c oncer ned department within the stipulated time, the bidder shall be liable for rejection/disqualification and shall not be considered for further technical or financial evaluation. 7. The Agency/Bidder must have a registered office/establishment within the State of Gujarat. Bidders/A ge ncies registered or established outside Gujarat shall not be considered for further evaluation or proc essing of the bid. The bidder shall submit valid documentary proof establishing its registration/establis hment in Gujarat. 8. The bidder must have a minimum of 3 work orders in GeM Similar work ( Swadeshi Mela ) only . Copies of work orders along with satisfactory completion certificates. 9.The bidder shall be required to obtain a Site Visit Certificate from the concerned department/authority af ter physically visiting the designated site/location. The duly signed and stamped Site Visit Certificate shall be submitted along with the technical bid. Failure to submit the required Site Visit Certificate shall render t he bid liable for rejection as per the terms and conditions of the tender. 10.The Nagarpalika reserves the absolute right to accept or reject any or all tenders, in whole or in part, wi thout assigning any reason, as per applicable rules and regulations. The decision of the Nagarpalika regard ing the tender process, evaluation, acceptance or rejection of bids shall be final and binding, subject to ap plicable laws and rules.All bidders shall abide by the terms and conditions of the tender and the decision of the Nagarpalika. If any bidder refuses to accept the declared tender result, raises any objection or submits any query, the same shall be dealt with strictly in accordance with the applicable GeM rules and tender con ditions. In case of any false, misleading, malicious or unjustified conduct, the Nagarpalika reserves the righ t to take appropriate action against the concerned bidder as per applicable rules and regulations. 11.The bidder shall submit a valid ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System (QMS) Certificate issued by an accredited certification body along with the technical bid. The certificate must be valid as on the date of bid submission and shall be submitted in a verifiable manner. Failure to submit the required ISO 9001:201 5 Certificate may result in rejection of the bid as per the tender terms and conditions. 12.Only bidders having a valid registered office or business establishment within the State of Gujarat shall be eligible to participate in this tender. The bidder must submit valid documentary proof of its Gujarat-bas ed establishment along with the technical bid. 13.The bidder shall submit soft copies of photographs of all completed similar works, clearly mentioning th e name of the work/project. The photographs and details shall be duly signed and stamped with the compa ny's official seal by the authorized signatory and submitted along with the technical bid. 14.Bidder/Supplier/Organization/Proprietor Must Submit No-litigation Certificate. .
